stem: A lab technician mixes a 20% salt solution with a 50% salt solution to make 30 liters of a 40% salt solution. How many liters of the 20% solution does the technician use?
solution: Let \(p\) and \(q\) be the liters of the 20% and 50% solutions: \(p + q = 30\).
verify:
p, q = symbols('p q')
sol = solve([p + q - 30, Rational(20, 100)*p + Rational(50, 100)*q - Rational(40, 100)*30], [p, q])
assert sol == {p: 10, q: 20}
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [sol[p]]
